jxggi.bio: Jxggi is a Brampton-based Punjabi-Canadian rapper whose melodic hip-hop catalogue includes They Don't Know, Big Plays, Breaking Boundaries and Inferno. HipHopCanada has covered him as a Canadian-based Punjabi artist, while Apple Music describes him as a Punjabi Canadian rapper. Why Me?, his 2025 collaboration with AR Paisley and Sickboi from the 4 Real EP, is his Northern Dial library credit.

jahmar carter.bio: Jahmar Carter is a Toronto-based producer and artist also known as Daxz and Lil DarkLord. As Daxz, he became known for production work connected to Drake's Grammy-nominated Back to Back and has worked with artists including KILLY, The Weeknd and Travis Scott. His co-credit with Shog Stan and WondaGurl on the 2026 single Girlfriend Pioneer Prodigy Veteran is his Northern Dial library credit.

lil darklord.bio: LIL Darklord is an alias of Toronto producer and artist Jahmar Carter, also known as Daxz. Carter emerged from Toronto's hip-hop production scene and has credits connected to Drake, KILLY, The Weeknd and other major artists. Slump City, his 2018 collaboration with WondaGurl from the Yesterday project, is the LIL Darklord credit in the Northern Dial library.

liza.bio: Liza is a Toronto-born Ethiopian-Canadian R&B and neo-soul singer-songwriter whose intimate, airy songwriting has earned national recognition, including a 2023 Black Canadian Music Award. Her catalogue includes February 29, DONE IS DONE and The Alternate Ending, alongside collaborations across Toronto's contemporary R&B scene. Five songs from The Alternate Ending era account for her Northern Dial library credits.

polo brian.bio: Polo Brian is a Vancouver-based British Columbia hip-hop artist whose off-kilter rap style has connected him with the West Coast independent scene. He reached a wider Canadian audience through Snotty Nose Rez Kids' 2021 single Wild Boy and later reunited with the duo on KIDS COME UP, IT'S SUPPERTIME! from I'M GOOD, HBU?. Those two collaborations are his Northern Dial library credits.
